name: Table Video
description: Peer-to-peer webcam video chat for your table. No server, no account.
author: George

permissions.name: camera
permissions.reason: Show your webcam to the rest of the table

permissions.name: microphone
permissions.reason: Talk to the rest of the table

permissions.name: autoplay
permissions.reason: Play the other players' audio and video without a click per tile

permissions.name: display-capture
permissions.reason: Only so a call service embedded via a shared call link can screen share
